newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 0.4 pct Mar 1-10 wk -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 0.4 pct Mar 1-10 wk -- CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States declined 0.4 percent in the 10 days of March 1-10 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos fell 0.9 percent, while U.S. sales of imports climbed 3.1 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 2.7 percent, to 192,244 from 197,652, CNW said. Domestic truck sales increased 1.3 percent, to 159,771 from 157,650, it said.
Import car sales rose 3.0 percent to 44,805, and import truck sales advanced 3.7 percent to 7,583, the report said.
Year-to-date sales were 2,501,234, up 0.01 percent from the same period last year, according to CNW.
